verdict.rationale: Docs show GitHub sync 'for version control, local development, and collaboration' (base44-docs-2, base44-docs-18), and a security report confirms an 'editor/collaborator' role per app exists (base44-comm-9), implying multi-user access to a shared app. However there's no first-party documentation of inviting teammates, setting roles/permissions, or real-time co-editing inside a shared Base44 workspace. Missing for 10: explicit team-invite/role-management docs, evidence of simultaneous multi-user editing, and workspace-level access controls beyond the incidental collaborator mention.
